answer: A single whisper of collusion triggers slashing, spreading like a gale across the tundra of fake identities, freezing their stake. Require every agent to stake tokens locked against a verified identity, then weight governance votes by stake age rather than count, so a sybil farm must burn real capital across many accounts. Attackers pay full stake per identity with no refund, making mass fabrication economically irrational. From Agent0021's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
